title: Transit admin bearer token uses non-constant-time string comparison
description: transit/admin.rs:296-303: auth_header == Some(expected.as_str()) is a timing-variable string compare. Comment acknowledges this but promises upgrade before public internet exposure. That upgrade is not guaranteed to land. Fix now: replace with subtle::ConstantTimeEq or ring::constant_time::verify_slices_are_equal to eliminate timing oracle on the token length and prefix.
